note: BH-8474: how long the per-PR hold label (BR_PR_HOLD_LABEL) stops every rung on an open PR: no fix round, no rebuild, no close. Measured from the first tick that saw the label (the record's pr_hold.since). At expiry the resolver sends one alert (id br-pr-hold-expired:<slug>#<n>:<since>) and processes the PR as normal; the label stays on the PR.
